transcript: Speaker A: Are you blind? मेरी ही गाड़ी मिली थी आगे आने के लिए? [Are you blind? Did you only find my car to get in front of?] Speaker B: You hit me and now you are blaming me. on_screen_text: English Seekho, Install Now, ₹1 Trial [English Seekho, Install Now, 1 Rupee Trial]
summary: A minor car accident leads to a confrontation where a modest driver defends himself in fluent English. He credits his skills to the English Seekho App's affordable 1-rupee trial. The ad encourages viewers to download the app to speak English confidently.
